messages:
maya: quick follow-up after the weekend incident where unioning claims granted org:admin unexpectedly. need a clear precedence.
ori: saw it. repro: client -> edge-proxy (client_claims) -> ingress (tenant_claims) -> operator-sidecar -> svc. mapper unions today.
sam: union is dangerous. propose deny-overrides + weighted precedence for permits.
tara: agree. define trust weights: service=100, operator=80, ingress=50, edge=40, client=10. tie-breaker = specificity (project id > wildcard).
maya: require provenance fields: role, scope, source, stamp_id. missing stamp_id => low trust.
ori: cap untrusted claims (max weight 20) so client can't escalate. also hard cap on claim count (200) to avoid blow-ups.
sam: ops metrics request: mapping_decisions_total, conflict_denied_total, sampled_conflict_payloads (0.1%), mapping_latency_ms.
tara: migration plan: week0 shadow logs; week1 ff canary 5%; week2 25% chaos; week3 rollout + audit retention. gating: <0.05% 4xx/5xx delta.
maya: i'll draft small RFC update and owners list.
ops-bot: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/security/issues/540 "claims-precedence-and-provenance" and attached traces.
ori: i'll open mapping-service PR for shadow mode.
sam: i'll add unit + fuzz tests and perf checks.
tara: infra, please schedule ingress-proxy stamp_id schema change next sprint.
maya: thanks everyone, drop repro payloads in the issue and tag incident-410.
